remarks: Discover urban living at its finest in this stunning 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo, perfectly situated in the heart of Stamford, CT. with 1,408 square feet of contemporary living space, this residence has the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and luxury. Step into an open-concept living area, featuring an updated and open kitchen with breakfast bar, sleek countertops, modern cabinetry, and stainless steel appliances-ideal for both cooking and entertaining. The spacious living room, adorned with new flooring, flows seamlessly into a large living and dining area, reading/office area and a private balcony, providing the perfect spot for morning coffee or evening relaxation.The condo boasts two oversized bedrooms both with closet systems from the Container Store and the primary suite features an ensuite bathroom with shower and built-in tiled bench for added comfort and privacy. Recent additional upgrades include a new HVAC system and a brand-new clothes dryer-yes this home provides you with your own in-unit laundry room-ensuring year-round comfort and convenience.Residents of this well-maintained elevator building enjoy access to a range of amenities, including a fully-equipped gym, Sauna and 2 parking spots- 1 of which is an assigned spot in the underground garage.Located within walking distance of downtown Stamford, you'll have quick access to vibrant nightlife, a variety of dining options, shopping, and entertainment.
